text: Part 1: Implement forward pass of cross attention. npt_f64 = npt.NDArray [np.float64] def softmax(s: npt_f64, dim: int) -> npt_f64: Softmax - forward Inputs: --s: A numpy array- of shape (N, M) —-dim: -Dimension to-do-softmax over Returns: - output: A numpy array of shape (N, M) #-exp(z)-/-sum(exp-z) # - pkkxImp lement - softmaxskokkkok s_shifted = s - np.max(s, axis = dim, keepdims=True) exp_s = np.exp(s_shifted) return exp_s / np.sum(exp_s, axis = dim, keepdims=True)
